name: GRBL / GRBL-ESP32
notes: GRBL 1.1 serial driver. Commission hardware before use.

name: xPRO V5 · Grbl_Esp32
notes: Original xPRO V5 serial. Rotary A requires an independent vendor XYAZ build and operator-confirmed degree calibration.

name: Marlin CNC
notes: Experimental serial driver. Requires CNC spindle configuration. No dynamic laser export.

name: FluidNC
notes: Experimental GRBL-compatible USB serial connection only. Requires numeric $30/$32 readback; no Wi-Fi transport or automatic YAML changes.

name: grblHAL
notes: Experimental GRBL-compatible USB serial. Rotary streaming requires independent axis, rotary mask and calibration readback.

name: LinuxCNC
notes: Router and drag-knife file export. Open in LinuxCNC. G54 tool-tip work zero, G49 cancels tool length offsets, G61 exact stop. No live bridge.

name: Mach3 Mill
notes: Router and drag-knife file export. Open in Mach3 Mill. Match the dwell units setting. G54 tool-tip work zero, G49 cancels tool length offsets, G61 exact stop. No Mach plugin.

name: Mach4 Mill / Router
notes: Router and drag-knife file export. Open in Mach4 Mill. G54 tool-tip work zero, G49 cancels tool length offsets, G61 exact stop. No Mach plugin.

name: UCCNC
notes: Router and drag-knife file export. Open in UCCNC. Match the configured dwell units. G54 tool-tip work zero, G49 cancels tool length offsets, G61 exact stop. No live driver.
